slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video filling the rounded-[48px] 600px hero card (object-cover scale-105, transition-transform duration-1000). autoPlay + loop + muted + playsInline, no overlays, sits in an absolute inset-0 z-0 layer behind all text.

Eight partner/brand single-color logo marks (svgl.app SVGs: Procure, Shopify, Blender, Figma, Spotify, Lottielab, Google Cloud, Bing) for the seamless marquee scroller. Each sits in a 96x160 (h-24 w-40) rounded-full white card and is inverted to solid black on group-hover (group-hover:brightness-0 group-hover:invert), so each must be a flat monochrome silhouette that reads when forced to black. The list is rendered twice inline to seamlessly loop. Each logo is data-paired with a per-card hex gradient object baked into the inline logos array (see reskinNotes), so item N's gradient hue is part of this socket.

Small circular brand logo placeholder on the left of the floating bottom navbar (w-9 h-9 white circle, slate-100 border, subtle shadow). Default is the star glyph '✦' (text character, not an asset); a brand swaps in its own monochrome mark/icon.

Display face for the hero headline (text-[42px] md:text-[56px], medium weight, tight tracking, color #0a1b33). Native family: Outfit (weights 400/500/600), imported from Google Fonts in index.css and wired to Tailwind --font-display.

Sans/body face for the subheadline, buttons, nav labels and marquee card labels. Native family: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700), imported from Google Fonts in index.css and wired to Tailwind --font-sans.

mechanic: A rounded 600px hero card holds an autoplaying object-cover background video behind a Motion fade-rise headline/CTA and a backdrop-blurred floating bottom navbar, with a separate pure-CSS @keyframes translateX(0->-50%) edge-masked logo marquee scrolling infinitely below it (pausing on hover, each card's gradient revealing on group-hover as the logo inverts to black).
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 (theme tokens --font-sans/--font-display declared in index.css) + Motion (motion/react) for hero entrance and button hover; lucide-react for the ChevronRight icon; marquee animation is a pure CSS @keyframes (no JS).
reskinNotes:
Every color is a literal Tailwind arbitrary value or slate utility hardcoded in JSX (bg-[#0a152d], text-[#0a1b33], text-slate-500, border-slate-200/50, etc.), not a CSS variable, so retinting means editing classes throughout. The 8 marquee logos live in an inline array where each entry pairs an svgl.app src + alt with a per-card hex gradient object (blue/yellow/purple/pink/green/teal) used for the group-hover reveal panel, so changing logos or their hover hues means editing that array, not the skin block. The hero headline copy is split across a literal
('Foundation of the' / 'new digital epoch') and all copy (headline, subheadline, 'Contact Us', '✦', 'Products', 'Docs', 'Get in touch') is hardcoded in markup. The hero card height is a fixed h-[600px] and the navbar logo is a text glyph rather than a real asset; logos are force-inverted to pure black on hover so any colored or multi-tone logo loses its color in that state.
